title: Keynote - Karen Sandler
summary: Karen Sandler's keynote at Linux.conf.au 2012 on the software running inside medical devices such as her own pacemaker-defibrillator. She discusses the difficulty of learning what code runs in life-sustaining devices and why open source matters there.
why: HN commenters point to it in threads about medical device security and software transparency as an excellent, personal case for open source in implants.

quote.text: here's a really excellent talk by Karen Sandler.
